name: gradbo
description: Find early-careers roles with Gradbo and apply with your own browser agent. Gradbo remembers your facts, answers, applications and employer accounts (encrypted, never your passwords) so you are never asked twice; your CV and documents stay in your folder.

token.title: Gradbo token
token.description: A token with read and write, from Settings › Connect your agent in the Gradbo dashboard. Stored securely by Claude Code.

server.title: Gradbo server
server.description: Leave as it is unless you run your own Gradbo server.
